input: import {ModelRuntime,createAgentSession,SessionManager,SettingsManager,DefaultResourceLoader} from '@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent';const normalize=v=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v,(k,value)=>k==='timestamp'||k==='durationMs'?undefined:typeof value==='string'?value.replaceAll(process.cwd().replaceAll('\\','/'),'<cwd>'):value));const r=await ModelRuntime.create({modelsPath:null,refreshOnCreate:false});const model={...r.getModel('groq','llama-3.3-70b-versatile'),baseUrl:process.env.SDK_CHAT_URL};const timing=[];let result,events=[];if(process.env.SDK_CANCEL_SESSION==='0'){const controller=new AbortController;const work=r.completeSimple(model,{messages:[{role:'user',content:'hello',timestamp:1}]},{apiKey:'fixture-key',maxRetries:0,signal:controller.signal});timing.push('returned');setTimeout(()=>{timing.push('aborted');controller.abort('fixture cancel')},500);result=normalize(await work);timing.push('settled')}else{await r.setRuntimeApiKey('groq','fixture-key');const loader=new DefaultResourceLoader({cwd:process.cwd(),agentDir:process.env.PI_AGENT_DIR,noExtensions:true,noSkills:true,noPromptTemplates:true,noThemes:true,noContextFiles:true,systemPromptOverride:()=> 'SDK system'});await loader.reload();const {session}=await createAgentSession({model,modelRuntime:r,resourceLoader:loader,sessionManager:SessionManager.inMemory(process.cwd()),settingsManager:SettingsManager.inMemory(),tools:[]});session.subscribe(event=>events.push(event.type));const work=session.prompt('hello').then(()=>timing.push('prompt settled'));timing.push('returned');let stopped;setTimeout(()=>{timing.push('abort called');stopped=session.abort().then(()=>timing.push('abort settled'))},500);await work;await stopped;result=normalize(session.messages.at(-1));session.dispose()}console.log(JSON.stringify({result,timing,events}));
